_comment: Copy this file to applicant.json (same folder) and fill in real values. applicant.json is git-ignored — it holds passport-level PII and must never be committed.
_dateFormat: Every date field accepts DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Both are converted to the ISO format the site's native date inputs require.
_nameNote: Split deliberately — the form has separate Name and Surname fields. 'fullName' is still accepted as a fallback for older files, but filling these two is more reliable.
_occupationNote: The form's Occupation is a dropdown. Whatever you write here is matched against the real options on the page; if nothing matches it is left empty for you rather than guessed.
_passportIssuedPlaceNote: A city or country (e.g. 'Ashgabat') — NOT the passport number.
_mainSupportingDocumentNote: Absolute path to the acceptance/invitation letter from the Turkish institution. The script attaches this file to the form's upload field. It never ticks the confirmation checkbox and never clicks Next Step — those stay your clicks.
_note: This file only covers the appointment-booking form's own fields. It does NOT replace the physical documents you must bring to the appointment — run the script to see the printed checklist, sourced from Mosaic Visa's own required-documents page for the Türkiye Student Visa (Ashgabat).
